variants.name: cascade-multi
findings: Fixed: › separated steps with the last step current; "2 selected" only on chosen groups; Record health shows names
Record health trigger with 4 conditions clamps at 2 lines and cuts "· +1" off ("…Porcine reproductive and…"; scrollHeight 59 > clientHeight 39): the worker cannot see that more are chosen

findings.text: Record-form names are line-clamped after "+n" is appended, so with long names the "+n" is the part that gets cut (Record health, 4 conditions: "Weakness or unsteady stance · Reduced appetite · Porcine reproductive and…").
findings.fix: Render "+n" in its own unclamped span after the clamped names span in pickerField, so the count is always visible.

findings.text: Medicine picker's sole Back is still drawn as the full-width filled primary button; everywhere else Back is secondary (round-2 finding, not fixed).
findings.fix: Render the medicine sheet footer with SentriUI.pickerFooter({multi:false}) instead of the host footer, which gives a secondary Back.

findings.text: Path written two ways: trigger "Antibiotics / Antibiotic B", sheet "All › Antibiotics".
findings.fix: pickerField: join path with " › " to match the step row.

findings.text: Reopening the medicine picker starts at All with nothing marked, so the current pick is not shown.
findings.fix: Host opens at the stored path's parent level with the chosen leaf selected.

findings.text: Atlas Overview demos Conditions (a record form) as "1 selected", and the cascade demo browses Symptoms under a Medicine label.
findings.fix: Overview: pass names:["Low appetite"]; cascade.html: use medicine categories for items.
